source.publication: 2025 Expanded Instructions (IA 1040) and the 2025 IA 1040 Iowa Individual Income Tax Return
source.section: IA 1040 form PDF p.1 Step 3 lines a, b, d; form PDF p.2 lines 1c, 2-5, 7, 8, 11, 12; Instructions PDF p.8 Step 3; PDF p.9-10 lines 2-4; PDF p.12 line 5 ('Iowa now has a flat tax rate of 3.8%'); PDF p.18 line 12; Schedule 1 line 7, PDF p.67-68 and form PDF p.5; Retirement Income Tax Guidance, 'Who qualifies'

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 40,000.00 + private pension (you) 20,000.00 = 60,000.00. Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 44,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IA 1040 filing status 1 (single). Step 3 line a personal credits 1 x 40.00 = 40.00; line b 0 x 20.00 = 0.00 (65 or older on or before January 1, 2026; nobody blind); line c no dependents; line d and line 8 = 40.00. Line 1c federal AGI 60,000.00; line 2 federal taxable income 44,250.00. Schedule 1 line 7 column B: pension 20,000.00 of you (age 50, under 55) stays taxed; line 7 total 0.00. Schedule 1 line 21 net modifications = 0.00; line 3 = 0.00. Line 4 Iowa taxable income = 44,250.00 + (0.00) = 44,250.00. Line 5 tax = 3.8% x 44,250.00 = 1,681.50; line 7 = 1,681.50. Line 11 total credits 40.00; line 12 balance = 1,681.50 - 40.00 = 1,641.50. State income tax 1,641.50 (no line 13-17 credits; line 19 school district or EMS surtax is local, not computed). The form allows whole-dollar rounding; expected keeps the cents. Low-income exemption test (PDF p.10-11): line 4 44,250.00 + federal deduction 15,750.00 = 60,000.00, against 9,000.00: not exempt. Single filers' tax reduction (PDF p.18): its worksheet 41-146 is not in the sources, so it is not applied. The form's figure is 881.50: a disabled recipient may exclude the pension at any age (PDF p.67), which would leave line 4 at 24,250.00 and the tax at 921.50. The projection does not know disability and taxes it.
accepted_approximations: Retirement income exclusion for a disabled recipient under 55; a projection does not know disability. Leaves the income taxed at 3.8%.
School district and county EMS surtaxes (a percentage of the tax, form line 19) are local and out of scope (issue #1).
